# How Far Ahead Should We Plan Specials?

## Why It Matters

Too late and specials are invented on Friday and costed after they sell. Too early and the fruit is not what we expected.

## Current Answer

Four weeks, fixed on the first Monday of each month, inside a twelve-month outline. Four weeks matches Stellan's availability sheet ([[brook-and-daughters-seasonal-availability-sheet]]) and leaves time for a Saturday test bake and for ordering. The twelve-month outline exists so Christmas and Easter are not a surprise.

## Evidence

From June to September 2026 every special ran as planned except one week in August when blackberries were short; Priyanka swapped in the apricot Danish from July. Specials averaged 66% margin, against an estimated 60% for the improvised specials of 2025.

## Revisit when

If the second site opens, central production would need a longer horizon ([[central-production-kitchen]]).
